allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates : We would like to inform you that the Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited, one of the promoters of Gujarat Industries Power Company Limited(GIPCL), has participated in the preferential issue of Equity Shares on private placement basis of (GIPCL) by equity share capital contribution of Rs. 44,99,99,806/- for setting up 75 MW AC Solar Power Plant by GIPCL under Group Captive mode. For more details kindly refer attach file.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates : This is further to our letter dated 11.08.2021 pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Company has paid consideration of Rs. 3.60/- Crores towards acquisition of 36,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each of Vadodara Jal Sanchay Private Limited today i.e. on 28.02.2025. The shares will be allotted by Vadodara Jal Sanchay Private Limited to the demat account of the Company in due course. For more details kindly refer attached file.
